notes:
Overview:
- Large European media archive (news + long-form features). ~50M documents, ~3TB text (post-processed), average raw length ~6k-9k tokens per doc.
- Primary need: enterprise RAG search for editors + legal discovery. High recall + high precision for complex queries.
- Current stack: custom ETL -> Postgres metadata + S3 blobs; experimenting with FAISS on two-node cluster.

Technical requirements / preferences:
- Embeddings candidate generation + reranker pipeline. Prefer two-stage flow: dense retrieval (ANN) -> cross-encoder rerank (top K).
- Latency SLO: median <=350ms for typical editorial query; p99 < 1200ms.
- Throughput: 30 qps sustained during peak editorial hours, spikes to 120 qps for discovery runs.
- Cost sensitivity: high on per-query reranker cost; willing to trade top-K and reranker size for cost savings.
- Chunking: long documents require semantic chunking and overlap. Interested in experiments: 512 vs 1024 token chunks, overlap 128-256, metadata-linked chunk ids to rehydrate results.
- Reranker tuning: exploring lightweight cross-encoder (DistilBERT cross-encoder) vs larger cross-encoders; discuss distillation and quantized CPU inference on Dedicated.
- Index scale: ~50M docs -> expected 250M chunks at 512 tokens. Need sharding + warm cache strategy.

Discussions so far (shorthand CRM notes):
- 2024-10-21: Intro call (Aisha, Mark) w/ Head of Search (Lars). Lars: "Need editors to find exact quote & context quickly — reranker has to keep precision high." Fireflies ff_2024-10-21_panoptic_1.
- 2024-10-28: Scoping follow-up: gave sample ingestion sizing, suggested baseline: embed+HNSW candidate retrieval (k=200) -> rerank top 20. Mark: cost estimate for 20x cross-encoder rerank per query.
- 2024-10-30: Technical deep-dive with infra (SLA), ops ask about VPC/private control plane. Legal loop: residency requirement (EU region only).
- 2024-11-01: Provided security FAQ and initial pricing deck. Panoptic asked about Dedicated vs Private route for lowest reranker latency.

POC proposal (high level):
- 6-week micro-POC: ingest 1M representative docs (mixed long-form news + transcripts) -> create chunk sets (512 and 1024 experiments) -> build vector index (HNSW) + implement candidate scoring -> deploy cross-encoder reranker for top 10 vs top 20 comparisons -> measure latency, recall@10/20, and cost per query.
- Deliverables: perf report, cost model, recommended chunking strategy, reranker size recommendation, sample rollout plan (canary + fallback to smaller reranker).

Risk & operational notes:
- Reranker on CPU vs GPU: cost tradeoffs discussed. Panoptic interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization, batch tuning, batching windows).
- Need ability to pin model versions and automatic fallback when Dedicated capacity is saturated (important for live editorial deadlines).
- Data residency & audit logging are hard blockers for procurement until legal signs off.

Next steps / owner actions:
- Aisha: schedule POC kickoff (week of 2024-11-11) once legal confirms residency note.
- Mark: produce detailed cost breakdown for 1M doc POC and full-scale extrapolation (50M). Include two reranker configs.
- Panoptic: send sanitized sample dataset S3 path + metadata schema.

User quotes / paraphrases:
- "If the reranker doubles latency but halves false positives, editors will accept it, but cost can't triple." — Lars (Head of Search).
- "We need deterministic fallbacks if GPU pools hit capacity during breaking news." — CTO
